o.norm: Objects of type org.apache.commons.codec.net.QCodec cannot be decoded using Q codec

i.norm: QCodec.decode(Object) only accepts {@code String} arguments. Passing any other type of object (here, the QCodec instance itself) must raise a DecoderException stating that the object cannot be decoded using Q codec.
Message: "Objects of type org.apache.commons.codec.net.QCodec cannot be decoded using Q codec"
